claim: The owner, for Gravesend: where a street ends at the map's edge it must look as if the town goes on behind, though unreachable -- not a wall cut off by sky -- as a continuation of the buildings beside the mouth, smaller buildings continuing behind tall thin ones. We answered it with the flanking buildings carried past the boundary wall at the same height and front, lower roofs behind, and a barred gate through which paving and lamps go on. E3M1 shows what lies past its edge with courts out of reach whose walls wear other buildings' tiles and sectors of no height under the sky.
evidence: the owner, 2026-11-25, kept in projects/blood-city/level/street_vistas.py:3-5 and :14-16: 'These walls on the city borders should have hint of continuing behind even it is unreachable, but it should make it to look better, now it is just cutoff by sky'; 'you need to think about it like continuation of the buildings you see next to it'
use: Build each end as an arrangement beyond the edge; raise floors of whole storeys for what stands behind, never lower the sky.
